meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加新通道或修改行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在定制 NanoClaw 的行为或集成新通道。
copy.tagline_en: Add new channels or modify NanoClaw behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are customizing NanoClaw's behavior or integrating new channels.

howto.what: 该技能会引导你逐步定制NanoClaw，例如添加新渠道（Telegram、Slack等）、修改助手行为或集成MCP工具。它先通过提问了解你的需求，然后推荐专用技能或指导手动修改关键文件。
howto.when: 当你想给NanoClaw添加新功能（如接入Telegram等渠道），或修改已有行为（如助手人格、指令）时触发。

say.note: 它会安装适配器并询问连接方式。

say.text: 帮我修改助手的人格设定。
添加一个新的MCP集成，连接日历。
say.note: 它会询问操作权限并配置。

howto.what_en: This skill guides you through customizing NanoClaw step by step, such as adding new channels (Telegram, Slack, etc.), modifying assistant behavior, or integrating MCP tools. It asks clarifying questions, then recommends dedicated skills or instructs you to edit key files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to add new capabilities (e.g., Telegram channel) or modify existing behavior (e.g., persona, instructions) of NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: It runs the install skill and asks how to wire it.
It guides you to edit the CLAUDE.md file.

say_en.text: Add a new MCP integration for my calendar.
say_en.note: It asks about permissions and configures the server.
